verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product is built around scheduled, recurring sync jobs (docs-1, docs-18) with configurable frequency down to 1-minute syncs (docs-11), and transformations that automatically execute after syncs or on a set schedule (docs-37, docs-4). This covers recurring data-pipeline 'jobs' well, though it's scoped to sync/transformation scheduling rather than general-purpose workflow orchestration. Missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary/custom workflow scheduling (e.g., DAG-style dependencies across non-Fivetran tasks) and independent hands-on confirmation of schedule reliability beyond general sync-reliability community comments.
